info.name: Naseej API
info.description:
## Import & run (full test)
1. Import **`Naseej.postman_collection.json`** and **`Naseej-Local.postman_environment.json`**.
2. Select environment **Naseej Local** and set **`MOYASAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET`** (same value as `.env`).
   - Or set collection variable **`moyasarWebhookSecret`** instead.
3. Do **not** put seed/crud IDs in the environment (only webhook secret + optional baseUrl).
4. Drop/recreate DB, restart app after `.env` changes, **Run collection**.

## Webhook secret
When `MOYASAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is set on the server, every webhook request must send header **`X-Webhook-Secret`** with the same value. When it is empty on the server, the header is not required.

## Moyasar
- **Test env:** Dashboard → Test Environment ON; Settings → copy `pk_test_*` and `sk_test_*` into `.env`.
- **Initiate (real sandbox charge):** `POST {{baseUrl}}/payments/initiate-moyasar` with `{ "userId", "purpose": "OPPORTUNITY_ACCESS", "useSandboxTestCard": true }` → stores real Moyasar id; may return `paid` immediately in test.
- **Sync (no webhook on localhost):** `POST {{baseUrl}}/payments/sync-moyasar/{localPaymentId}` after hosted checkout.
- Webhook: `POST {{baseUrl}}/payments/webhook/moyasar`
- Status: `GET {{baseUrl}}/payments/get-status/{moyasarPaymentId}`
